📖 How to use

  1. Enter the buy price, number of shares and buy commission.
  2. Enter the sell price and sell commission.
  3. Read net profit, return % and the breakeven sell price.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the breakeven price?

The sell price per share where profit is exactly zero: (buy cost + both commissions) ÷ shares.

How is return % calculated?

Net profit ÷ total buy cost (shares × buy price + buy commission), as a percent.

Does this include dividends?

No — only the price trade. Add dividends received to the sell proceeds mentally for total return.
